name: The Pledge of Secrecy
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Goblin engineering is about practical uses for high profit and higher explosive power!  Our schemata allow us to make powerful bombs and mighty weaponry; the manual you read covered this.

The manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata.  Once you become a goblin engineer, that's that.  There is no access to gnome engineering at all.

If you still want to become a goblin engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again.  Think about it carefully, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome aboard, Goblin Engineer adventurer! You soon will have access to the most powerful engineering schemata anywhere on Azeroth.

Now that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your goblin-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your goblin engineering talents!
narrative.requestItemsText: If you've signed the document and are ready to hand it to me, then that is that. You've been told that this is a one way trip. If you're ready, then hop on board!
